Subject: Request: credits for LaunchScale winter cohort

Hi Olga,

Hope you’re well — I run operations at LaunchScale Partners. We run a winter batch for 10 early-stage startups (SaaS & infra) and want to provide each founder with Redwood free credits to test model integrations during the program.

We have a roster attached (LS_Winter_roster.csv) with company names, domains, and a primary contact for each team. Typical ask: 100k token-equivalent credits per startup for 3 months (pilot). Before I push this to our founders, I need a verification that:

- This qualifies under your "accelerator / VC program credits" self-serve flow
- What evidence you need from us to activate credits at scale
- Any per-account limits or terms we should be aware of

We’d like the onboarding window to begin next week (week of 19 Jan). Please let me know the fastest path — we can share a signed program agreement or a short CSV if that’s sufficient.

Thanks — Sarah

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Linden <sarah@launchscale.vc>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:34:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: credits for LaunchScale winter cohort

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the roster. I can help get this moving. Quick answers up front:

- Yes — accelerator/VC cohort grants are supported via our self-serve issuance for verified programs.
- We need:
  1) A roster with company name, domain, and admin email (CSV is ideal) — you’ve sent that, thank you.
  2) Confirmation that each founder has permission to receive credits (a single signed program MOU is OK).
  3) Expected start date and per-account credit amount.

Can you attach the signed MOU or NDA if you have one? If not, we can accept a one-line confirmation from your legal ops contact and we’ll proceed with a conditional issuance while we collect the MOU.

Operational notes:
- For cohort-level issuance we create a HubSpot program record and generate redeemable self-serve credit links per founder. Those links are single-use and expire after 30 days.
- Per-account cap: for this flow we'll tentatively approve up to 150k token-equivalent per account; any requests above that require a brief review by our partnerships team.

I’ve looped in Ben (cc) to approve program-level credits. If possible, please send the signed MOU and the point of contact for procurement (name + email).

Best,
Olga Petrov
Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

2) We approved 120k token-equivalent credits per founder (<= 150k cap) for up to 10 founders on the roster (deal id LS-2026-WINTER-09).
3) Issuance method: we’ve generated single-use self-serve credit links. I’ll paste the program issuance portal link below — when a founder clicks their link it will prompt them to sign into Redwood and redeem the credits into their org.

Issuance portal link: https://app.redwood.ai/credits/issue/LS-2026-W09
Doc with redemption FAQ and limits: https://docs.redwood.ai/accelerator-credits

Operational notes:
- Links will be emailed to the roster addresses you provided; if a founder needs the credits assigned to a different email, reply-all with that mapping and we’ll reissue.
- Credits go live within 24 hours of redemption. If any founder needs an extended expiry or higher cap, loop me and we’ll evaluate.

I’ll trigger the send once you confirm we should distribute to the emails in the attached CSV.

Best,
